_comment: The captain's origins (character creator, Origins.cs). A birth (how you were raised) and a past (what you did before the company) each carry effects applied once when a campaign starts, an age added to 20, an optional free perk, and the line the log shows. Effects: gold:N, renown:N, food:N, horses:N, opinion_realm:N (lords of your homeland), skill:Id:N, gear:id (owned), wear:id (owned and worn), men:troop:N (base men, scaled by ArmyScale), free (no contract: a free company), buff:effect:days (a boon laid on the map when the campaign begins: an effect from effects.json carried into every battle; 0 days = the whole campaign). Events with trigger origin:<id> come only to captains of that birth or past.

births.name: Born in the Hall
births.text: A younger child of a minor house. You learned your letters, your manners and which lords hate which.
births.line: Your father's name still opens a door or two.

births.name: Born to the Plough
births.text: Free farmers on good land. You walked behind oxen, shot at the butts every Sunday and know what men eat.
births.line: Lads from your old parish walked out after you.

births.name: Born in the Market
births.text: Your family kept a counting house. You can read a ledger, smell a bad coin and talk a price down.
births.line: Your mother's last letter came with a purse in it.

births.name: Born in the Baggage Train
births.text: A camp follower's child. You grew up between wagons, sutlers and surgeons, and saw your first battle at eight.
births.line: You have never slept anywhere but a camp.

births.name: Raised in the Cloister
births.text: Left at a chapter house's gate. The brothers taught you herbs, Latin and patience before you ran off.
births.line: You still know the old prayers for the dying.

births.name: Born on the Marches
births.text: A border keep where the raiders came every harvest. You learned to ride before you could read, and to sleep with your boots on.
births.line: Three riders from the old keep followed the smoke of your fires.

births.name: Born at the Forge
births.text: Your father beat iron for the whole valley. You pumped his bellows, ground his edges and know good steel by its ring.
births.line: The mail on your back is your father's work. He made you swear to keep it oiled.

births.name: Born by the Sea
births.text: Fisher folk on a cold shore. You hauled nets in the surf, salted the catch and learned that the weather always wins.
births.line: Barrels of salt fish ride in your wagons. The men curse them and eat them.

pasts.name: Sellsword
pasts.text: Twelve years in other men's companies. You know what a soldier costs and how to make him cost less.
pasts.line: Six of your old file signed on the day you raised your banner.

pasts.name: Hedge Knight
pasts.text: A knight with no land, only a horse, a name and a long road between tourneys.
pasts.line: Heralds still know your arms from the lists.

pasts.name: Disinherited Heir
pasts.text: The land was yours until your uncle bought the judge. Now you have a name, a grudge and men who remember your father.
pasts.line: Three of your father's riders came with you. They want the land back.

pasts.name: Deserter
pasts.text: You walked away from a lord's war when it turned to murder. Nobody pays a deserter, so you are your own master now.
pasts.line: You fly no realm's colours. Some lords have not forgotten whose you once wore.

pasts.name: Poacher
pasts.text: The king's deer fed your village for six winters. You know every deer path, ford and hollow tree in the forest.
pasts.line: The woods are as good as a road to you.

pasts.name: Reformed Outlaw
pasts.text: You held up the north road for years and bought a pardon with the takings. Old habits: you never let a beaten man get away.
pasts.line: Your pardon is sealed, but the roads still whisper your old name.

pasts.name: Barber-Surgeon
pasts.text: You sewed up other captains' men for a decade, then decided you could lead them better than the fools who got them cut.
pasts.line: Your saws and needles ride in the first wagon.

pasts.name: Drill Sergeant
pasts.text: Twenty years shouting at recruits on a lord's parade ground. You can make a soldier out of almost anything.
pasts.line: You have turned worse rabble than this into a line.

pasts.name: Returned Pilgrim
pasts.text: You walked to the far shrine to wash off a sin, and came back with sunburnt feet and a stillness men follow.
pasts.line: Pilgrims you met on the road took up spears when you raised your banner.

pasts.name: Siege Sapper
pasts.text: Ten years under other men's walls: digging saps, building mantlets, counting the stones on the parapet.
pasts.line: Your old diggers came with you. They still carry their shovels.

pasts.name: Tourney Champion
pasts.text: You won a gold circlet at the great lists and spent it in a month. Crowds know your face. Captains know your price.
pasts.line: Your sallet still has the dent from the final tilt.

pasts.name: Lord's Steward
pasts.text: You kept a lord's rolls, stores and stables until he died and his heir sold everything. You know what an army eats.
pasts.line: You left with the keys to a granary nobody else remembered.

roads.name: Sword and Shield
roads.text: On foot behind a kite shield, as most good soldiers fight. Slow to fall.

roads.name: Lance and Saddle
roads.text: A warhorse under you and a boar spear for the charge. Few on foot will stand it.

roads.name: The Bow
roads.text: A hunting bow in hand, the sword at your side. You hit what you aim at.

roads.name: The Greatsword
roads.text: Both hands on a long blade and no shield. You strike first and hardest, and you take the blows that come back.

roads.name: Halberd and Line
roads.text: You learned your trade in the pike line: chop, hook and thrust from out of reach, and know where the next blow will fall.
